Building: Panthéon, Paris (mausoleum (former church)).
The front (−z) is the portico, facing down the Rue Soufflot.
Footprint: 84.9 m along x by 112.1 m along z, centred on the origin.

3 photographs attached, in order:
  1. front three-quarter from the corner: Corinthian portico with pediment and the tall drum and dome, daylight
  2. view of the rear and side of the cross-shaped body with the drum and dome above, trees in front
  3. elevated view of the whole portico front and flank across the square, daylight
